text: Ethereum is outpacing Bitcoin today, gaining 2.8% versus Bitcoin's 1.4%, suggesting modest rotation toward altcoins despite Bitcoin holding near $84.6k. Fear & Greed has climbed to 71 (Greed) with a +15 point weekly jump, reflecting renewed risk appetite, though Bitcoin dominance remains elevated at 58.3% and volume at $109B is solid without being exceptional. The pattern indicates cautious optimism—traders are willing to reach for gains but haven't abandoned defensive positioning around Bitcoin yet.
